import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the CSV file
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')

# Group by region and calculate the minimum order count per region
grouped_df = df.groupby('region')['orders'].min()

# Plot the minimum order count for each region
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
grouped_df.plot(kind='bar', color='skyblue')
plt.title('Lowest Monthly Order Count for Each Region')
plt.xlabel('Region')
plt.ylabel('Minimum Orders')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
